pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers_in_rj FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'

SELECT strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_delivered_order
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_reviews FROM reviews WHERE review_score = 5 AND review_creation_date >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND review_creation_date < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-08-01';

SELECT p.category_en, COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
  AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.category_en
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.region, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-05-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-08-01'
GROUP BY r.region
ORDER BY gmv DESC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') = '2017-11'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS active_sellers_sp
FROM sellers s
WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
      AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-06-02'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_ratings
FROM reviews
WHERE review_score <= 2
  AND CAST(review_creation_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2018-04-01' AND DATE '2018-06-30';

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_time_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-03-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01';

WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_customer_pct
FROM cust_orders;

WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         s.seller_state,
         CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) AS is_late
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT seller_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_late THEN order_id END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS late_rate
FROM delivered
GROUP BY seller_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 100
ORDER BY late_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-02-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-02-01'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
              THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.delivery_status, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM d
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
GROUP BY d.delivery_status
ORDER BY avg_review_score;

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT r.region, p.category_en, oi.price
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL
),
gmv AS (
  SELECT region, category_en, SUM(price) AS gmv
  FROM valid
  GROUP BY region, category_en
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, category_en, gmv,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn
  FROM gmv
)
SELECT region, category_en, gmv
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY region, gmv DESC;

WITH co AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y') AS yr
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  SELECT customer_unique_id
  FROM co
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
  HAVING MIN(yr) = '2017'
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
) t;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
) t;

WITH sp_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date, c.customer_state
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP'
    AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT customer_state,
       AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_wait_days
FROM sp_orders
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY avg_wait_days DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM reviews r
WHERE r.order_id IN (
    SELECT oi.order_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG'
);

WITH order_paid AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS paid_amount
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT AVG(op.paid_amount) AS avg_paid_per_order
FROM order_paid op
WHERE op.order_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher'
)

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND p.category_en = 'health_beauty'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
  AND order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

WITH monthly_gmv AS (
  SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
  GROUP BY month
),
growth AS (
  SELECT month,
         gmv,
         LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_gmv
  FROM monthly_gmv
)
SELECT month,
       CASE WHEN prev_gmv IS NULL OR prev_gmv = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (gmv - prev_gmv) / prev_gmv, 2)
       END AS gmv_growth_pct
FROM growth
ORDER BY month;

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.price
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
),
seller_gmv AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS gmv
  FROM valid
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT SUM(gmv) AS top_gmv
  FROM (SELECT gmv FROM seller_gmv ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 20)
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv FROM seller_gmv
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top_gmv / NULLIF(total_gmv, 0), 2) AS top20_gmv_pct
FROM top20, total
